propositions: Superseded tickets with live supersedes/duplicates links cannot be closed without --force despite matching link-backed administrative disposition evidence
The plan-review close gate function lacks access to close_class parameter and cannot exempt administrative dispositions even though completion verification gate exempts them identically

Link-backed administrative closes (superseded, duplicate) should skip plan-review attestation when live replacement link exists, matching the evidence standard applied to completion verification elsewhere
A genuinely superseded plan's review necessarily blocks on substantive findings (described work already exists), making attestation unsatisfiable by construction
Force-closing a superseded ticket strips completion signatures from ancestor epics; retroactive remediation through reopen/re-close remains blocked until gate accepts evidence-backed disposition
